name: Alistair Finch
bio:
Alistair Finch is a rising star in the British independent film scene. Fresh out of film school, his short films have already garnered critical acclaim for their innovative cinematography and emotionally resonant storytelling. Known for his collaborative spirit and intense dedication to his craft, Alistair thrives on bringing compelling narratives to life. 

His connection to motorsport is nascent but growing. Alistair is currently developing a documentary series about the human drama behind Formula racing, focusing on the mental and physical toll on the drivers and their teams. He believes the intense pressure and high stakes of racing provide a fertile ground for exploring themes of ambition, sacrifice, and resilience, making a racing driver a potential subject for his upcoming work.

physical.description: Alistair has a youthful, almost boyish face, often framed by his unruly hair. He tends to dress in practical, comfortable clothing, favoring dark colors.

connectionToMotorsport: Alistair is developing a documentary series about Formula racing, offering a behind-the-scenes look at the drivers and their teams.
